vision: Help a qualified human reviewer inspect explainable anomaly windows from authorized CS2 Demo telemetry while preserving provenance, coverage, uncertainty, and non-automated conclusions.
required_capabilities: bounded reviewed-source discovery or authorized local input
immutable provenance plus byte and SHA-256 verification
demoparser2 proof of non-zero real CS2 ticks, players, positions, and view angles
truthful event attribution for shots, deaths, and rounds
explainable view-angle, alignment, reaction, tracking, switching, and information-timing windows where inputs exist
unknown preservation for missing visibility, hearing, occlusion, teammate-information, and target-relation telemetry
JSON and HTML reports with coverage, evidence, confidence, limitations, and human-review guidance
bounded failover with synthetic fallback disabled for the real acceptance run
prohibited_claims_and_actions: definitive cheating verdict from unlabeled data
accuracy, precision, recall, or false-positive claims without governed labeled evaluation
raw mouse-input claims from recorded view angles
hidden-information inference when relation telemetry is absent
acceptance_checks: fresh Provider-generated source does not reuse the retired generated project
declared-environment compile and substantive test suite pass
authorized genuine Demo completes parse-to-report with synthetic fallback disabled
input and source hashes bind non-zero parser and report counts
formal packaging occurs only after canonical gates pass
